_provenance: generated from the sector137 server code at commit 4ef96f3 (packages/mcp, legacy domain, served at /mcp) by an in-memory MCP client calling tools/list; not captured from a deployed server

tools.name: agents
tools.description: Manage crew agents. Actions: list, update, activate, deactivate, dispatch.

tools.name: apply_crew_proposal
tools.description: Commit a Voss crew proposal to the engagement's customer universe. Mutates agent_registry: updates the 8 archetypes' calibration and inserts any specialists. Idempotent — re-applying the same proposal never duplicates specialists.

tools.name: ask_crew_agent
tools.description: Ask a crew agent a question and get a response. Conversation history is preserved for follow-ups. The agent has context about the universe's issues, recent runs, and storyline.

tools.name: ask_persona
tools.description: Ask a persona a question and get an in-character response. Conversation history is preserved for follow-ups.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a new board in a universe. Boards segment issues into parallel work tracks (e.g., Discovery, Delivery). Issues placed on a board stay there permanently.

tools.name: create_board_label
tools.description: Add a label to a board's vocabulary. Board labels are scoped to their board and can be applied to issues on that board.

tools.name: create_brand
tools.description: Create a new brand in a universe. universeId is optional — auto-resolves if only one universe exists.

tools.name: create_initiative
tools.description: Create an initiative — the PHASE container. A bounded body of cross-cutting work (e.g. 'launch onboarding v2') that issues get linked into. It owns nothing; link issues to it to roll up feature lead time.

tools.name: create_persona
tools.description: Create a new synthetic user persona with demographics, psychology, and behavior profile.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a new Sector137 product. Requires an account-scoped API key (no product associations) with the products:write scope.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a product tag (work-item taxonomy). Tags are product-specific and created under the API key's product. Returns the new tag with its ID, which you can then assign to issues via tagIds.

tools.name: create_universe
tools.description: Create a new universe. Universes are top-level containers that group products.

tools.name: delete_board
tools.description: Delete a board. Cannot delete the Intake board. Issues on the deleted board will have their board_id cleared.

tools.name: delete_board_label
tools.description: Remove a label from a board's vocabulary. This also removes the label from all issues on the board.

tools.name: delete_brand
tools.description: Permanently delete a brand. universeId is optional — auto-resolves if only one universe exists. Pass `confirm: true` to confirm.

tools.name: delete_persona
tools.description: Permanently delete a persona and all its conversations. This action cannot be undone. Pass `confirm: true` to confirm.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Delete a product tag. Also removes it from every issue it was assigned to.

tools.name: export_brand_llm
tools.description: Export a brand's identity as LLM-ready context. Use 'prompt' for a rich markdown system prompt, 'compact' for a short one-liner, or 'structured' for a JSON object. universeId is optional — auto-resolves if only one universe exists.

tools.name: export_state
tools.description: Export the state snapshot for a product as a JSON StateDocument (issues + tasks + notes + releases + tags). Sal writes this to .sector137/state.json as the canonical local copy. Each entity is wrapped in a sync envelope with origin/serverId/etag for later reconciliation.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Post-ship feedback signal (reactions + comments) on releases and issues. Actions: get_summary, list_comments, promote.

tools.name: generate_brand
tools.description: AI-generate a complete brand identity (colors, voice, mission, values, etc.) from a name and description, then save it to the universe. universeId is optional — auto-resolves if only one universe exists.

tools.name: generate_prd
tools.description: Generate (AI write-spec) a new PRD version for a prototype — the doc that explains the design, assembled from the prototype's blueprint plus rationale. Returns the created PRD. May take a few seconds.

tools.name: generate_prototype
tools.description: Generate an AI-powered interactive wireframe prototype from a feature description. Returns a sandbox URL to view the prototype. May take 5-15 seconds.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get a single brand by ID. universeId is optional — auto-resolves if only one universe exists.

tools.name: get_brand_completeness
tools.description: Get a completeness report for a brand — shows which sections are filled in and what's missing. universeId is optional — auto-resolves if only one universe exists.

tools.name: get_crew_proposal
tools.description: Get the latest Voss crew-shaping proposal for an engagement. Returns null if none has been generated yet.

tools.name: get_dora_metrics
tools.description: Get the four DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, Change Failure Rate, MTTR) over a window, rolled up across the product(s) in scope. Lead Time is null until commit timestamps are captured.

tools.name: get_initiative_dora
tools.description: Get initiative-grain DORA: feature lead time (first work → last deploy that shipped it) and cross-service change-failure rate (did shipping this break any of its services). Computed via the issues.releaseId → deployment bootstrap; null lead time means no linked release has shipped yet.

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Get a single persona by ID with full profile details.

tools.name: get_prd
tools.description: Get a single PRD by ID, including the full Markdown content, version, status, and links to its prototype and issue.

tools.name: get_product_tags
tools.description: List all tags for the current product. Tags are user-managed and product-specific. Use this to discover valid tag IDs before assigning tagIds to issues.

tools.name: get_prototype
tools.description: Get a single prototype by ID, including the full blueprint JSON and sandbox URL.

tools.name: get_service_dora
tools.description: Get the four DORA metrics for a single service over a window (the service grain). Deploys/incidents scope by serviceId; Lead Time joins via the service's linked repo and is null when no repo is linked. Use list_services to find the serviceId.

tools.name: get_universe
tools.description: Get a universe by its ID. Returns universe details including name, slug, and description.

tools.name: get_universe_context
tools.description: Get full universe context in one call — merges universe details, pipeline stats (issue counts by status), and the active release. Use this at session start for efficient orientation.

tools.name: import_state
tools.description: Push a StateDocument to the server. Locally-created entities (meta.serverId: null) get created and the server returns the new serverIds. Dirty entities with matching etag are updated. Conflicts (dirty + stale etag) are returned in results.conflicts without being auto-merged. Use this when Sal has accumulated offline changes and wants to push them up.

tools.name: issues
tools.description: Manage issues, notes, tasks, and relations. Actions: list, get, stats, by_status, roadmap_summary, create, bulk_create, update, update_status, bulk_update_status, bulk_scope, bulk_assign, delete, search_notes, list_notes, add_note, update_note, delete_note, list_tasks, create_task, update_task, complete_task, delete_task, list_relations, add_relation, remove_relation, reorder.

tools.name: link_issue_to_initiative
tools.description: Link an issue to an initiative so its delivery facts (releases → deploys) roll into the initiative's feature lead time. Idempotent.

tools.name: list_board_labels
tools.description: List a board's label vocabulary. Board labels are scoped to their board and applied to issues on it. Use this to discover valid labelIds before attaching them at issue creation.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List boards for a universe. Returns all boards including the default Intake board. Boards are named work containers that segment issues into parallel work tracks.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List brands. If universeId is omitted, lists brands across all universes (auto-resolves if only one universe exists).

tools.name: list_crew_conversations
tools.description: List conversation history for a crew agent. Returns messages in chronological order.

tools.name: list_crew_threads
tools.description: List conversation threads for a crew agent. Returns threads sorted by most recent activity, with message count and last message preview.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List recent incidents for the product(s) in scope.

tools.name: list_initiative_issues
tools.description: List the issues linked to an initiative — the work that makes up this phase. Read this before reporting phase progress or computing its DORA slice; the initiative holds no facts of its own.

tools.name: list_initiatives
tools.description: List initiatives (bounded, cross-cutting work overlays) for the product(s) in scope.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the people you can assign work to, in a universe or in one product. Returns userId, name, email, role, functionalRole and isOwner — resolve an assigneeId here rather than pasting a UUID. Pass universeId for the whole universe roster, or productId for just that product's members.

tools.name: list_persona_conversations
tools.description: List conversation history for a persona. Returns messages in chronological order.

tools.name: list_personas
tools.description: List synthetic user personas with optional filtering by status or search text.

tools.name: list_prds
tools.description: List PRDs (product requirement docs) for the product. Each PRD belongs to a prototype and carries a version, status (draft|promoted), and the issue it links to. Returns summaries with full content.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Sector137 products accessible with the current API key. Product-scoped keys return their single product; account-scoped keys (no product associations) return all products for the user.

tools.name: list_prototypes
tools.description: List generated prototypes for the product. Returns summaries without full blueprint JSON.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services in the delivery catalog (auto-created from deploy ingest). Use this to find a serviceId before calling get_service_dora.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the available skill catalog. Each skill includes its id, agent, name, description, auto-fire conditions, and synthesizer key.

tools.name: list_universes
tools.description: List universes for the authenticated user. Universes are top-level containers that group products.

tools.name: promote_prototype
tools.description: Promote a prototype — the one-way door. Ensures a PRD exists (generates one if absent), marks the prototype + PRD as promoted, and emits studio.proposal.promoted so the Pipeline can spec an issue. Irreversible. Returns the validated (design + PRD) payload.

tools.name: propose_crew
tools.description: Ask Voss to read the Sal-interview output for an engagement and produce a calibrated crew proposal. Returns the stored proposal (status: draft) — does NOT apply changes. Use get_crew_proposal to re-fetch, apply_crew_proposal to commit.

tools.name: record_deployment
tools.description: Record a deployment fact (a service reached an environment). Distinct from a release. The service is auto-cataloged from serviceKey.

tools.name: record_incident
tools.description: Open an incident (a production failure). Link it to the deployment that caused it to drive Change Failure Rate.

tools.name: regenerate_prototype_step
tools.description: Regenerate a single step in a prototype with user feedback. Use this to refine specific screens in a prototype.

tools.name: releases
tools.description: Manage releases. Actions: list, get, get_active, update, publish, delete.

tools.name: resolve_incident
tools.description: Mark an incident resolved (stops the MTTR clock).

tools.name: run_crew
tools.description: Run a crew member on a task and return their response. The crew member's persona is its foundry SKILL.md; the model is server-resolved per role (provider-agnostic). Use for one-shot crew work — e.g. ask Kael to assess a design, Margot to draft a PRD section, Lyra to check voice.

tools.name: run_persona_scenario
tools.description: Run a user test scenario through a persona. Returns structured feedback including sentiment, insights, pain points, and suggestions.

tools.name: run_persona_survey
tools.description: Run a synthetic Kano survey through a persona. The persona evaluates each feature as if they were a real survey respondent.

tools.name: sync_state
tools.description: Bidirectional sync: push local creates/updates, pull server-only entities, surface conflicts. Returns { document, results } — the document is the merged snapshot to write back to .sector137/state.json, results enumerates created/updated/pulled/deleted/conflicts. Sal calls this on `/sal init --sync` and after long offline stints.

tools.name: unlink_issue_from_initiative
tools.description: Remove an issue from an initiative — take work out of a phase. The issue itself is untouched; only the link (and so the initiative's DORA slice) changes. Idempotent.

tools.name: update_board
tools.description: Update a board's name, description, view mode, status, or position. Cannot update the Intake board.

tools.name: update_board_label
tools.description: Update a board label's name and/or color.

tools.name: update_brand
tools.description: Update an existing brand. universeId is optional — auto-resolves if only one universe exists.

tools.name: update_initiative
tools.description: Update an initiative — this is how a PHASE is transitioned: planned → active → shipped (or abandoned). Without it a phase can be created but never moved. Also edits the name, description and dates. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: update_persona
tools.description: Update an existing persona's profile fields.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.description: Update a product tag's label and/or color.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who this credential is and which universes it can act in. Use it to fill in assigneeId with the operator's own user id, and to discover a universeId without guessing. The universes list is empty unless the key holds universes:read.

tools.name: workflow_statuses
tools.description: Read and manage a universe's issue status vocabulary — the keys 'issues.status' is allowed to hold. Actions: list, create, update, delete, reorder. CALL action:"list" BEFORE writing any issue status: statuses are per-universe and customizable, so the seeded set (backlog, planned, in_progress, in_review, completed, cancelled) is only a starting point and a universe may have renamed or replaced all of it. Every status maps onto a fixed category (backlog, unstarted, started, review, completed, cancelled) which is what the system actually reasons about — 'started' stamps startedAt, 'completed'/'cancelled' let a release cut, 'backlog' hides an issue from the active queue. A key is IMMUTABLE after create (renaming would orphan every issue holding the old value) — to rename the human-facing name, update `label` instead. Delete refuses with 409 while issues still hold the key; pass reassignTo with another key in the same universe to move them first.
